method: Median of observed rounded first-token prefill rates per trial; partial provider-turn coverage. Not request-duration-weighted and not pure prefill time. No inference or changes to raw trial records.
caveats: First-token and terminal rates describe different request boundaries; structured rates would take precedence, but all historical samples here are first-token details.
Internal tool-loop requests, cancelled turns and event-stream gaps may be missing. Reconnect replays without stable event IDs cannot be identified beyond exact duplicate lines.
TTFT includes scheduling/first-token work; neither TTFT nor trial input tokens can reconstruct exact prompt duration from these rounded observations.
